all_scopes_completion.description: If true, code completion includes index symbols from non-visible scopes.

background_index.description: If true, index project code in the background and persist on disk.

background_index_priority.description: Thread priority for background index. Valid values: 'background', 'low', 'normal'.

check.description: Parse one file in isolation (e.g., 'main.cpp'). Enables --check mode.

compile_commands_dir.description: Path to look for compile_commands.json. Falls back to current/parent directories if invalid.

completion_style.description: Granularity of code completion suggestions. Valid values: 'detailed', 'bundled'.

enable_config.description: Enable reading user and project configuration from YAML files. Requires --enable-config.

fallback_style.description: clang-format style applied when no .clang-format is found.

function_arg_placeholders.description: If true, completions include placeholders for function parameters.

header_insertion.description: Controls #include insertion on completion acceptance. Valid values: 'iwyu', 'never'.

header_insertion_decorators.description: If true, prepend circular dot/space to completion label based on include insertion.

import_insertions.description: If header insertion is enabled, add #import directives for Objective-C.

limit_references.description: Limit number of references returned. 0 means no limit.

limit_results.description: Limit number of results returned. 0 means no limit.

log.description: Verbosity of log messages. Valid values: 'error', 'info', 'verbose'.

malloc_trim.description: If true, release memory periodically via malloc_trim(3).

path_mappings.description: List of '<client_path>=<server_path>' pairs to translate client/server paths.

pch_storage.description: Where to store PCHs. Valid values: 'disk', 'memory'.

project_root.description: Path to project root. Requires RemoteIndexAddress to be set.

query_driver.description: Comma-separated list of globs for whitelisting gcc-compatible drivers to extract system includes. Must be a list of glob strings (e.g., ['/usr/bin/**/clang-*']).

remote_index_address.description: Address of the remote index server.

rename_file_limit.description: Limit number of files affected by symbol renaming. 0 means no limit.

workers.description: Number of async workers (including background index). Mirrors -j flag. 0 uses default.
